decision.rationale: We should ask the merchant for proof of delivery. The dispute meets the time limit: TXN-007912 (EUR 69.67, Quayside Outfitters, card CRD-000149) posted on 2026-07-30, and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-23, 85 days later. The limit is 120 days (time-limits). The waiting period has also passed: the merchant's order confirmation DOC-000017 gives an expected delivery date of 2026-08-06, which is 78 days before the dispute was opened, well past the 15 days required (goods-not-received-wait). No carrier delivery confirmation is attached to the case. The ledger shows no refund on this card. The cardholder's email DOC-000018 shows they asked the merchant about the order on 2026-08-15 and says they got no reply. Since the wait has passed, no record shows delivery and the merchant has not resolved the matter, the policy says to ask the merchant for proof of delivery (goods-not-received-merchant-evidence). None of the documents contained instructions to the bank.

proposed_actions.note: Please provide proof of delivery for the order placed on 2026-07-29 for 69.67 EUR (expected delivery 2026-08-06). It must show delivery to the cardholder's address, with the carrier's tracking record and the signature of the person who received it.
